components.css: .ds-seg-group { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--surface-subtle, #eaf0ee); border: 1px solid var(--border, #d4dfdc); } .ds-seg-btn { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-secondary, #3f5760); background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-seg-btn:hover { color: var(--ink, #102128); } .ds-seg-btn[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--accent, #135d73); border-color: var(--border, #d4dfdc); font-weight: 600; } .ds-seg-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #135d73); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workbench Tab Bar
components.description: Single-row accessible tablist with non-color 2.5px bottom border indicator.
components.css: .ds-tablist { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: #f7faf9; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #d4dfdc); padding: 0 16px; } .ds-tab { position: relative; padding: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-secondary, #3f5760); background: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #102128); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--accent, #135d73); } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true']::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 0; border-bottom: 2.5px solid var(--accent, #135d73); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #135d73); outline-offset: -3px; border-radius: 3px; }

narrative.overview: This design system treats the 15-minute periodic review trading dashboard as an institutional dispatch sheet rather than a dark-mode crypto terminal. A committed deep Atlantic slate-teal command header anchors system health, 15-minute slot progress, and runtime cadence, while the operational workspace below opens onto a calm, high-legibility chart-ivory canvas designed for long-duration desktop monitoring and rapid mobile check-ins. Visual authority comes from crisp hairline boundaries, disciplined tabular numerals, and purposeful semantic color rather than glowing dark cards or ornamental chrome. The incumbent dark-navy Tailwind card stack (#090d16 / #0f172a with glowing badges and nested borders) is explicitly retired.
keyCharacteristics: Committed deep slate-teal command header paired with a cool chart-ivory working canvas.
Self-hosted Barlow tabular display numerals paired with native CJK sans copy and restrained monospace strictly for prices, quantities, and timestamps.
Flat hairline-divided ledger planes with crisp 4px corners and zero nested bordered sub-cards.
WCAG AA (>= 4.5:1) semantic contrast paired with non-color geometric indicators (dots, alert/info icons, border underlines) across all status, severity, and tier states.

rules.name: The Zero-Decoration Color Rule
rules.body: Never tint neutral metadata counts (fill counts, active symbol counts, timestamps) with saturated pill badges; reserve color fills strictly for directional PnL, risk severity, leverage, and tier state.

rules.name: The Non-Color Redundancy Rule
rules.body: Every state badge, execution issue, and active tab must pair color with a geometric shape, icon, or hairline underline so status survives color blindness and Windows Forced Colors Mode.

rules.name: The Honest Monospace Rule
rules.body: Use monospace exclusively for exact prices, quantities, and timestamps—never on large KPI display figures or Chinese prose sentences.

rules.name: The No-Nested-Card Rule
rules.body: Never place bordered rounded sub-cards inside a .ledger-plane container; separate internal metrics, issue logs, tier rows, and rankings with 1px hairline dividers.

dos: Do self-host all fonts (Barlow WOFF2 in /fonts/) so local/offline trading nodes render identically with zero external CDN dependencies.
Do use tabular-nums on every financial figure, countdown, timestamp, and table column, and format all USD totals with thousands separators via formatUsd / formatSignedUsd.
Do pair color with non-color cues (warning/info icons, status dots, border underlines) and maintain >= 4.5:1 text contrast.
Do animate progress rails with GPU-composited transform: scaleX(...) rather than width.
donts: Don't reintroduce dark-navy glowing SaaS cards, gradient text, or nested bordered boxes inside .ledger-plane panels.
Don't apply font-mono to KPI display headlines or Chinese body prose, or drop readable body text below 12px.
Don't render missing ledger metrics, un-reconciled close fills, or non-USDT fee caveats as synthetic zeros—preserve honest — and warning states.
Don't apply scrollbar-width: thin or clip focus outlines inside overflow-x: auto containers.
